ns2:course.label: MEMS Devices & Systems
ns2:course.description: Introduction to principles, fabrication techniques, and applications of microelectromechanical systems (MEMS). In-depth analysis of sensors, actuator principles, and integrated microfabrication techniques for MEMS. Comprehensive investigation of state-of-the-art MEMS devices and systems. Same as IE 485 and ME 485. For engineering majors with senior standing.
